role: cross-run drift anchor for the CI/CD gate WARN branch (IR2)
purpose: Persists THIS run's finding totals so the NEXT run's gate can decide its WARN branch. Directive 9 compares total findings against a previous baseline that no directive produces, so without this file WARN is undecidable. Counts only - no finding text, no path, no secret.
run_id_basis: sha256 over the four normalized per-layer findings artifacts concatenated in the fixed order arch-audit, semgrep, taint-analysis, osv-scanner, truncated to 16 hex characters. Content-addressed and host-independent: identical layer artifacts always yield this identifier, and no hostname, user, absolute path or process id contributes to it.
codebase_baseline_commit_note: The audited codebase state every layer measured, identical to the value run-metadata.txt and codebase-profile.txt record. Deliberately not the current HEAD, which advances with each artifact commit and is never a measurement basis.
coverage_basis: No record in any contributing layer carries coverage=partial and neither persisted coverage summary reports a partial category, so this run is complete and its totals are a clean anchor. A partial run escalates the verdict to ERROR and its totals must not be adopted as a baseline without noting the partiality.
gate_counts_note: gate_blocking and advisory are recorded as drift provenance only. The gate's BLOCK branch reads findings-layer-3b-taint.json directly; it never reads this file. Under REPRODUCIBILITY the gate-blocking set is the stable anchor across runs, while advisory findings may legitimately vary - which is what the 20 percent tolerance absorbs.

warn_branch.rule: WARN if: no gate-blocking, but total findings exceed previous baseline by >20%.
warn_branch.comparison: next_run.total_findings > previous.total_findings * 1.20 => WARN; otherwise, absent ERROR and gate-blocking findings, PASS
warn_branch.tolerance_provenance: The 20 percent figure is the requirements' own and is the only threshold this artifact carries. The repository declares no security SLA, KPI or coverage threshold, and none is invented here.
warn_branch.precedence: ERROR > BLOCK > WARN > PASS, strict and non-overlapping. A pipeline failure outranks a vulnerability finding, and a gate-blocking finding outranks any count comparison.
warn_branch.sole_consumer: the WARN branch of gate_verdict in findings-merged.json
warn_branch.first_run_semantics: When this file is ABSENT, WARN is structurally unreachable and the verdict falls through to PASS, given no ERROR status and no gate-blocking finding. That is the intended behaviour, not a defect. No synthetic prior baseline is ever fabricated to make WARN reachable: absence is meaningful.

merge_projection.algorithm: Inter-layer-only deduplication on (file, line, cwe) per AAP A8: two findings from the same layer never merge, so each key contributes max(per-layer count) records and corroborated counts the records that absorbed two or more layers. Same-layer collapsing is forbidden because every Layer 4 record shares one lockfile path and line 0, which would fabricate corroborations.
merge_projection.authority: Informational drift diagnostic only. findings-merged.json is authoritative for post-merge figures, and the WARN comparison keys on total_findings, never on these values, so a projection that differs from the merged report cannot change any verdict.
corroboration_examples: Dockerfile:94 CWE-250 - arch-audit and semgrep independently
apps/api/v2/Dockerfile:26 CWE-250 - arch-audit and semgrep independently

derivation.excluded_input_reason: The merged report CONSUMES this artifact for its WARN branch. Reading it here would invert the dependency direction and create a cycle, so this artifact is written before the merged report and never reads it.
derivation.total_findings_definition: The sum of the lengths of the four normalized per-layer findings arrays, with any layer documented ERROR in layer-status.json contributing zero.
derivation.equality_with_merged_summary: Verification check 11 defines findings-merged.json _summary counts as that same sum, so total_findings equals _summary.total_findings by construction - no read of the merged report is required to guarantee it.
derivation.error_layer_rule: A layer documented ERROR contributes zero to every count here, is named in layers_documented_error, and may legitimately lack its normalized artifact.
derivation.severity_vocabulary_enforcement: An out-of-vocabulary severity, an unparseable input, a missing input, a non-integer line, a non-boolean gateBlocking or a by_severity total that disagrees with total_findings aborts generation with a specific reason. Nothing is silently coerced and no count is silently zeroed.
derivation.counts_are_actual: Every number here is the actual measured count. Nothing is rounded, padded or trimmed to make a future comparison look favourable (E8).
derivation.severity_inflation_disclosure: AAP A7 applies the requirements' severity map literally to the SARIF level vocabulary (error->critical, warning->high), which systematically inflates semgrep severities relative to the scanner's own semantics. It shifts by_severity and therefore the count comparison that drives WARN; it never affects BLOCK, which keys exclusively on Layer 3b exploitability. A reviewer comparing baselines should read the skew as intentional and systematic, not as drift.

provenance.note: E10 - these counts are only comparable across runs produced by the same tool versions and the same pinned rule packs. run-metadata.txt carries the full provenance: acquisition sources, rule-pack sizes and stanza counts, per-layer exit codes, durations and every documented version deviation.

constraints.serialization: single-line minified JSON object, compact separators, unescaped Unicode, zero embedded newlines
constraints.path_style: every path named here is repository-relative
constraints.determinism: run_id is content-addressed and therefore identical for identical inputs; generated_at is a wall-clock stamp, so this artifact is intentionally not byte-identical across runs. That is correct: it is a per-run anchor and is not one of the deterministic layers (0, 2, 3a, 4) that the reproducibility mandate binds.
